preconditions.description: The number of integers n is between 1 and 400,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in a)
preconditions.description: The input list a contains exactly n integers, each between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The total number of cells x equals the product of dimensions p and q.

postconditions.expression: len(rect) == p and all(len(row) == q for row in rect)
postconditions.description: The output rectangle has exactly p rows and q columns.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(row)) == q for row in rect)
postconditions.description: Every row in the rectangle contains distinct values.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(col)) == p for col in zip(*rect))
postconditions.description: Every column in the rectangle contains distinct values.

postconditions.expression: all(all(val in a for val in row) for row in rect) and sum(1 for val in a if val in [cell for row in rect for cell in row]) >= x
postconditions.description: All values in the rectangle are chosen from the input array a, respecting their available multiplicities.
The area x is the maximum possible area among all valid beautiful rectangles constructible from the input.
